definitions.throw: First post-integration tick with a targeted pass in flight; nearest defender center distance.
definitions.catch: First post-integration tick after an offensive catch, before subsequent carrier movement.
definitions.opportunity: Engine catch-contest separation (includes catchable incompletions; missing on off-target/deflected passes).
definitions.trace: X receiver every 0.5 seconds through 4 seconds, rep 0 / roster seed 7, selected before outcomes.
